title: Successive canonical derived open restriction

proof.text: Use the actual module upperStar and upperStarComp of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Allow a flexible composite fg by preceding upperStarComp with equality transport. Substitution into the existing upperStarComp_hom_app_comp_upperStarComp_hom_app equation proves its three-fold associativity, including the commutative-square transports.

Lift this associativity through exact derivation. Expand mapDerivedCategoryTriangleIso. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso under left and right whiskering, preservation of natural-isomorphism composition, and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_assoc identify the two derived three-fold comparisons. All these are existing proved source-library lemmas; the private generic helper is proved in the item module.

Define the flexible exact-derived square as inverse source triangle followed by target triangle. Apply the preceding associativity equation to the three triples (i′,i,f), (i′,f′,j), and (f′′,j′,j), using the common composite (i′i)f. Cancel the intermediate invertible comparisons to obtain its horizontal pasting equation; inversion gives the equation of TwoSquares. Preservation of isomorphism composition, inversion and equality transport identifies the square with the inverse of derivedOpenCoherencePullbackSquare and its triangle comparisons with openCoherenceRestrictionComp of [def-sfb-derived-direct-image-open-coherence-data].

Apply mateEquiv to the pasted-square equation for the specified exact-left/right-derived adjunctions. Use mateEquiv_vcomp and naturality in the two non-adjoint sides [lem-weil-pbc-mate-whisker]. The resulting mates are exactly derivedDirectImageOpenRestriction. Evaluate at K and remove the identity components of functor associators. This is the displayed DirectImageSuccessiveRestriction equation. Only the commutative-square parts of the pullback hypotheses are used.
